Computer Codex
Grade 8–9 · Coding & Robotics · Digital literacy

The computer skills every learner needs.

Computer Codex covers the practical computer skills learners are expected to have and are rarely taught: using Windows and organising files, Word and Excel, and then the thinking behind coding, from decomposition and algorithms to pseudo code, flow diagrams and how AI and machine learning work.

Word and Excel lessons, from saving and styles to SUMIF, absolute references and charts.

Questions

Which subject is it for?

It is built for Grade 8–9 Coding & Robotics, and works for any learner who needs the computer basics before Computer Applications Technology or IT.

Do learners need Microsoft Office?

No. The lessons explain and practise the skills inside Computer Codex; having Word and Excel available makes a good extension.

How much does it cost?

Computer Codex is one of thirteen tools on The Magic Lab. Start with a free account; full access to every tool is one plan, and schools can get a quote for all their learners and teachers.
